svg.title: Arena.vie architecture: eight steps from picking a round to a graded scorecard
svg.text: Students practice the rounds companies really run, with an assistant that can read and change their code only
through tools they can see, and a judge that runs everything in the browser.
Company-tagged problems in that company's real editor format
Python on Pyodide, JavaScript in a web worker
Chat about the code, or hand it a task in agent mode
List, read, edit and test files in a sandboxed repo
Every file write waits until the student accepts the diff
pytest runs in the browser, so no server runs student code
An edge function rotates 4 open models when one is rate limited
A JSON rubric grades the round when the clock runs out
TYPESCRIPT · REACT · SUPABASE EDGE FUNCTIONS · PYODIDE · WEBRTC · YJS
The code is private. This shows the architecture.
